description:
Two calls. Without challenge_id and signature: returns a one-time challenge for one
controller. Sign its `message` with that controller, then call again with challenge_id
and signature. A wrong signature uses up the challenge. With both a key and a wallet,
prove each (registration status lists what is still to prove).

challenge_id.description: Leave empty to get a new challenge
challenge_id.title: Challenge Id

controller_type.description: When getting a challenge: which controller to prove, ed25519 (the key) or eip155 (the wallet). By default the next one still to prove.
controller_type.title: Controller Type

signature.description: Signature of the challenge message: Ed25519 (base64url) for a key, or the wallet's personal_sign / signMessage result (0x...) for a wallet
signature.title: Signature

name: debitmydata_prove_wallet_control
title: Prove control of the controller key or wallet
